title: TBI-HippoAtlas: analysis code and web platform for the chronic post-traumatic mouse hippocampal single-nucleus and translational reference atlas
description: Reproducible R and Python analysis pipeline and interactive web platform source code for TBI-HippoAtlas (companion to NCBI GEO dataset GSE333879, chronic 30-day post-CCI mouse hippocampal single-nucleus RNA-seq atlas).
